items.title: Level Design
items.description: I have contributed to game projects through level design, combining creative ideas with the technical work involved in building a playable experience. I am continuing to develop these skills during my game development studies.

items.title: Game & Software Programming
items.description: I have contributed programming work to team projects and worked as a developer at AdariaGroup. My studies in application development have given me a foundation in Java, SQL, HTML and CSS that I bring to new development challenges.

items.title: Team Collaboration
items.description: I have worked with teams on projects, contributing to both level design and programming. I enjoy sharing ideas and learning from others, and bring initiative, responsibility and a willingness to help to the work we do together.

items.title: Systems & Technical Support
items.description: My background includes network systems administration studies, HelpDesk work at Escola Pia Sant Antoni and experience as a virtual reality lab technician. These experiences complement my game development studies with practical IT knowledge.
